user.title: Add local solar inverter
user.description: Choose the inverter vendor. The integration is read-only and polls locally.

sungrow.title: Connect to Sungrow
sungrow.description: Local read-only SG5K-D telemetry over the Sungrow encrypted Modbus transport.

goodwe.title: Connect to GoodWe
goodwe.description: Local read-only MS/MS G3 telemetry. Auto transport tries SolarGo/UDP 8899 then Modbus TCP 502 once during setup and caches the working path.
